'''Vinda''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She worked as a mechanic for the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Varas Hoorst]], in Hoorst's [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] repair shop in the [[platform city]] [[Bayonard]].
